lesson: The system is consistently failing by attempting to front-run trend reversals against strong momentum, resulting in five consecutive stop-outs during deep markdown or impulsive phases. Relying on RSI oversold conditions in a bearish structure has proven to be a liquidity trap rather than a reversal signal.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'No-Counter-Trend' rule: only execute trades that align with the 4h/1d EMA ribbon direction, ignoring all RSI divergence signals until a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or structural CHoCH occurs.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based mean reversion less; prioritize SMC structural flow and order flow confirmation.
